lede: The biggest item this week is the Ouray County BOCC's November 10 meeting, which carries two public hearings — one on the Curry Regular PUD, a proposed 14.42-acre lot split on County Road 1, and one on a 2026 budget amendment — plus a vote on whether to repeal an austerity resolution from last year. San Miguel County's Planning Commission follows on November 12 with a work session on proposed changes to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee, a structure that directly shapes whether workforce housing gets built here. Ouray's Planning Commission also meets November 10 to take up a proposed ordinance on natural medicine restrictions under Proposition 122.

notable.stake: Public hearings on a lot-split PUD, budget amendment, and austerity resolution repeal.
